address: 10/15 Convent Road, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: Relocated to the Si Lom area, the same team continues to operate under Chef Francesco Deiana. Vibrant blue and white tones greet you, and the atmosphere inside remains welcoming. Enjoy dishes from Italy's regions and watch fresh pasta being shaped by hand at the counter. Finished with pungent Pecorino Romano, the saffron gnocchetti with baby lamb ragù are gently aromatic, the pasta shells perfectly chewy. Weekend cookery classes reveal the secrets behind his recipes.
